# Gnom-Hub (landjunge/gnom-hub-v1)
> Local multi-agent control hub — brainstorm freely, Execute only on purpose.
> No Docker. Python + FastAPI. Visible agent cards. Safe computer-use.
> Brand: landjunge · Not GNOME desktop software.


- Site: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/
- DE: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/de.html
- Docs: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/docs.html
- Ecosystem: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/ecosystem.html
- Launch: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/blog/launch.html
- Press kit: https://landjunge.github.io/gnom-hub-v1/press/
- Repo: https://github.com/landjunge/gnom-hub-v1
- Discussions: https://github.com/landjunge/gnom-hub-v1/discussions

## Product rules
- Send / chat = dialogue and planning only
- Execute = start workers that may spend money or touch files
- Computer-use stays dry-run until deliberate God-Mode
- Optional Tollgate integration for Protect · Route · Prove

## Sibling project
- Tollgate (agent safety layer): https://landjunge.github.io/tollgate/
- Repo: https://github.com/landjunge/tollgate
- 10-min cold path: https://landjunge.github.io/tollgate/blog/checklist.html

## Stack
- Python, FastAPI, local desktop-first
- Default LLM: DeepSeek (configurable); optional Ollama
